title: Adorable Cups
review_text: These are the cutest little cups. My kids love them. The colors and pictures on the cups are darling. They don’t break if dropped. But they feel like big kid cups because they have no lids. My only issue is that they are squeezable. So, little hands trying very hard to manage with one hand squeeze the cup and spill the contents. They are a little wide for my 4 and 5 year olds to use one hand, but they insist on trying anyway. If they were a little firmer or a little more narrow, I feel like we wouldn’t have as many squeeze and spill issues.
sentence: These are the cutest little cups.

title: Great for soothing
review_text:
We have an infant daughter and she likes to be swaddled. They like things around them - it's why they will sleep for hours in their car seat but wake up as soon as you put them in the crib (at least mine does). Swaddling with a regular blanket can be tricky. It can be difficult to do and then easily come loose. It can also be an issue because you are not supposed to put a blanket in with the baby in the crib.

I liked these. It made it so much easier to swaddle her. You just put her in it and Velcro and you are done. I still don't put her in it alone in the crib at night, but just to use while I am holding her. It also can make it easier to breastfeed because sometimes she inadvertently loses the latch because she is moving around so much. This seemed to calm her down. It's nice that it comes in a set of two. They were soft and had nice designs. These colors are nice because they are neutral, but still cute, especially the print. It's good for someone who doesn't know the gender or for someone who is planning on having more kids and would like it to last longer. I also think this would make a nice shower gift. I like that it is organic cotton. I think it makes them a little nicer. I would recommend them.
sentence: We have an infant daughter and she likes to be swaddled.
